question: What range of manifestation is described as effect in the teaching?
premises: The arising of the world begins as effect with nāda, bindu, and so on.
In the teaching this range extends up to Sadāśiva.
It also includes what begins with the earthly level.
inference: The scriptural teaching treats the whole manifest range, from subtle nāda-bindu down to earth and up to Sadāśiva, as produced effect.
uncertainties: The verse is syntactically compressed and continues the thought from the previous verse.
plain_english: The arising of the world as effect begins with nāda, bindu, and so on. In the teaching, this includes everything from the earthly level up to Sadāśiva.
